events.description: Gotobeat is excited to team up with GORILLA to present 1000Mods live. 1000Mods - It’s no wonder why 1000mods are considered one of Europe’s most iconic heavy rock bands worldwide. Since their genesis two decades ago, the Greek powerhouse has become a true staple of the international rock scene out thanks to their anthemic songcraft and hundreds of fire-driven live performances across the globe. From the early-day breakthrough of stoner rock milestones “Super Van Vacation” (2011) and “Vultures” (2014) to the overdriven rock’n’roll charge of “Repeated Exposure to...” (2016) and the ambitious alt-rock shift of “Youth of Dissent” (2020), 1000mods let the power of music speak for itself with their no-frills attitude and strong DIY ethics. Transcending genre boundaries and bringing together generations of faithful fans, 1000mods stands as a unique voice of hope and empowerment for those who are lucky to cross their path. Slated for a November 2024 release on Ouga Booga and the Mighty Oug Recordings (world) and Ripple Music (US), their highly anticipated fifth album “Cheat Death” is set to be their heaviest record to date, delivering ten powerful sonic statements packed with metal and punk influences while still delivering a few shiver-inducing gems along the way. 1000mods are ready to trample upon the heavy rock world and take no prisoner, and you’d better be ready for it!

Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg (Jacob Tremblay), Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. From Emmy Award-winning filmmaker Poh Si Teng, American Doctor follows three American medics who travel to Gaza to volunteer in hospitals overwhelmed by war. Palestinian-American emergency physician Dr. Thaer Ahmad, Jewish American orthopaedic surgeon Dr. Mark Perlmutter, and Zoroastrian trauma surgeon Dr. Feroze Sidhwa come from very different backgrounds but are united by a shared commitment to save lives. Working amid bombardment, severe medical shortages and constant danger, the doctors treat patients under extraordinary circumstances while witnessing the devastating impact of the conflict. They are compelled to not only care for the wounded but also to speak out about what they have seen.

Weber's Clarinet Concertino in E Flat Major was written in 1811 for the renowned clarinettist Heinrich Baermann and helped establish the clarinet as one of the great solo instruments of the Romantic era. Though modest in scale, it is rich in character, combining lyrical warmth with dazzling displays of virtuosity. Weber explores the instrument's full range, from its mellow lower register to its brilliant upper sonorities, creating music of charm, energy and sparkle. Michael Collins, the Ulster Orchestra's Principal Guest Artist, takes the solo role. Collins is then joined by Guylaine Eckersley, the Orchestra's Bassoon Section Leader, for a performance of Richard Strauss's Duet-Concertino for Clarinet and Bassoon. Written in 1947, it was one of the composer's final completed works and reveals a more intimate side of Strauss, far removed from the vast orchestral forces of his earlier tone poems. The contrasting colours and personalities of the clarinet and bassoon are woven together with warmth, humour and elegance, creating a captivating musical conversation. Across its three movements, Strauss creates music of great refinement and charm. The programme concludes with Michael Collins conducting Mozart's Symphony No. 40 in G minor: a work combining beauty and drama with extraordinary craftsmanship. From its restless opening movement to its energetic finale, Mozart's masterpiece remains one of the crowning achievements of the Classical era, continuing to captivate audiences more…

events.description: Known for her powerful storytelling, lightning-fast wit, and hilariously irreverent musical interludes, Emer has cemented herself as one of Ireland’s most exciting comedic voices. Recently named one of the top 10 new comic talents in the UK by Channel 4, Emer’s star continues to ascend sharply. She has also recently been commissioned by Channel 4 to write and star in sitcom Socially Awkward - a hilarious, heartfelt sitcom about her life as an autistic adult. Perfectly Chaotic sees Emer dive into the beautiful mess of modern life - from questionable decisions to personal revelations, from daily disasters to the unexpected moments that shape us. Delivered with Emer’s trademark honesty, musical brilliance, and no-holds-barred humour, this show promises belly laughs, emotional whiplash, and more than a few moments of “I probably shouldn’t relate to this... but I absolutely do.” A heartfelt, laugh-out-loud rollercoaster you won’t want to miss.

events.description: Dom Martin, one of the most celebrated blues artists of his generation and a multi award-winning UK Blues Hall of Fame inductee, brings his explosive blend of Celtic Blues Rock to Ulster Hall on 28 November 2026. As part of the acclaimed Legacy Sessions, Spirit of Gallagher ’72 sees Dom return to the very stage where Rory Gallagher made history, performing a set inspired by that iconic New Year’s Day 1972 concert. Expect searing guitar work, soul-stirring vocals and a night steeped in Belfast’s rich musical heritage, a powerful resurrection of one of Ulster Hall’s most defining moments. From chart-topping albums including Buried In The Hail (Blues Album of the Year) to sold-out tours across the UK and Europe, Dom Martin is the real deal and this promises to be an unforgettable celebration of Irish blues at its very roots. This performance is a tribute and is not officially endorsed by the Rory Gallagher Estate or its affiliates.

Hosted by radio presenter Rebecca McKinney, this special event brings together outstanding musical performances with powerful stories of hope and resilience and will raise vital funds to help the charity support children, young people, and families living with the impact of cancer. Nestled in the flickering glow of candlelight, attendees will be treated to a mesmerising evening of music and connection with performances included the charity’s own Care Free Choir, made up of families supported by the charity, staff and volunteers. Meeting regularly to sing, connect and support one another, the Care Free Choir provides a safe and uplifting space where members can find friendship and a sense of belonging through a shared love of music. For many members, the choir has become an important part of rebuilding confidence and rediscovering joy beyond cancer. As one parent living with a cancer diagnosis describes: 'Being sick takes away all control, strips you of your identity at times and leaves you feeling depleted. Being part of choir reverses that. I remember my first ever time at choir. I felt like me again; strong, fun and confident. I felt understood without having to say a word. I felt full again.' This sense of connection, empowerment and hope lies at the heart of the Twilight Concert and reflects the life-changing support that Cancer Fund for Children provides to families across the island of Ireland. The choir will be joined by talented violinist Romeo Jiang. A former member…

Boundary breaking pioneers fusing the omnipotent power of the orchestra with innovative technology and the raucous rebellion of rock, London Symphonic Rock Orchestra deliver iconic rock hits in the most spectacular way. A collective of 12 classically trained artists brought together by their love of rock music and immense talent, the LSRO formed in 2018 and have been wowing audiences ever since. LSRO have collaborated and performed with many artists including the Trevor Horn Band and Queen Machine and have played more than 200 shows to over 400,000 fans! Dressed as an army of rock warriors, LSRO perform whilst immersed in a candlelit fantasy forest. The atmosphere is electric, the musicians are mesmerising and the supersonic, 100% live, wall of sound they create leaves the audience instantly captivated. Expect reimagined classic hits from: AC/DC, Led Zeppelin, Metallica, Iron Maiden, Guns n Roses, Evanescence, Motörhead, Foo Fighters, Rage Against The Machine, System Of A Down and many more.

events.description: AGMP Presents This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s AGMP presents THE STYLE COUNCILLORS The Style Councillors are the world’s one and only tribute to The Style Council. Formed in 2013 by Darren Fletcher (Paul Weller) and Steve Hayes (Mick Talbot), The Style Councillors have quickly built a loyal fanbase for the group which was Paul Weller’s home for the majority of the 1980’s and where he wrote some of his finest songs. Dani Clay (Dee C. Lee) and Craig Read (Steve White) are joined by the Bad Manners Horn Section and a stellar line up of musicians hell-bent on recreating the sound of The Style Council. After the dissolution of The Jam in 1982, Paul Weller joined forces with Mick Talbot, formerly of The Merton Parkas, Dexys Midnight Runners and The Bureau, to form The Style Council. The band released a string of succesful singles between 1983-1989 such as Speak Like a Child, Money-Go-Round, Long Hot Summer, My Ever Changing Moods, You’re The Best Thing, Shout To The Top, Walls Come Tumbling Down, A Solid Bond In Your Heart, Come To Milton Keynes, The Lodgers, Why I Went Missing, and more. This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

title.en: Ulster Orchestra: Once Upon a Time

events.description: Visit the magical land of the fairy tale, as we perform some of the loveliest musical versions of those best-loved stories that have been read for generations. The performance of Humperdinck’s richly evocative music from his opera Hansel & Gretel is a German Christmas tradition, while Tchaikovsky’s suite from the ballet The Sleeping Beauty is a shimmering, magical depiction of good and evil fairies, Puss in Boots and the slumbering Princess Aurora. Mozart’s joyful, elegant Piano Concerto is a sparkling companion to these stories from the opera and ballet stage. Englebert Humperdinck Hansel & Gretel Suite Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart Piano Concerto No. 9 Jeunehomme Piotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky The Sleeping Beauty Suite Piotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky Polonaise from Eugene Onegin Samy rachid conductor Jonathan biss piano

ai.en: AJJ, the American folk-punk band formed in Phoenix in 2004, plays at Black Box in Belfast. The band blends folk punk, anti-folk and experimental music.

events.description: AJJ, originally known as Andrew Jackson Jihad, is an American folk-punk band formed in 2004 in Phoenix, Arizona. The band is celebrated for its distinct blend of genres, including folk punk, anti-folk, and experimental music. With lyrics that often touch on themes of shyness, poverty, humanity, and politics, AJJ has carved out a unique space in the contemporary music scene. The founding members, singer and guitarist Sean Bonnette and bassist Ben Gallaty, have remained the only constants in the band’s lineup since its inception. Their first studio album, Candy Cigarettes & Cap Guns, was released in 2005, showcasing their early sound and lyrical depth. The album was well-received and marked the beginning of a prolific career.

ai.en: Elvana, an Elvis-fronted tribute to Nirvana, plays Mandela Hall in Belfast, mashing up Nirvana's catalogue with rockabilly and Elvis Presley songs.

events.description: ELVANA - THE WORLD'S FINEST ELVIS FRONTED TRIBUTE TO NIRVANA! From somewhere deep in the bowels of Disgraceland, the King of Rock & Roll steps out of the afterlife, plugs in, and takes the mic for the band that changed the ’90s forever. Elvis fronts Nirvana. No compromise. Just pure, electrified chaos. Blending the swagger of rockabilly with the raw punch of grunge, Elvana rips through Nirvana’s catalogue while smashing it together with the finest moments of Elvis Presley’s legacy. Expect overdriven riffs, hip-shaking grooves, loud guitars, louder screams, and the kind of mash-ups that feel wrong until they feel absolutely perfect. It smells like cheeseburgers and teen spirit, daddy-o. Described as “Bafflingly Brilliant” by The Guardian, “Absolutely f**king epic” by NME, and “The only band worth getting excited about this year” by Vice, Elvana have built a reputation as one of the wildest live experiences on the planet. Even Billy Idol joked that if Elvis were still around, he’d probably be covering Nirvana anyway. Two icons. One stage. Zero rules. If you haven’t seen Elvana yet, you’re missing out.If you have, you already know… and you’re probably checking tour dates right now. Stupid and contagious. In the absolute best way. 🎸🔥👑 AGE RESTRICTION: 18+ Only

events.description: The UK's biggest indie party in 18 cities and counting, is finally coming to Northern Ireland for An Afternoon of Indie at The Belfast Empire Music Hall Strictly over 30s only, this is one for the slightly older indie kids. Door Times: 3pm-7pm We've hosted indie events in 18 other cities too Brought to you Old School Indie Feeling Gloomy (turning 20 this year) & Age Against The Machine our DJs will be playing a mix of indie classics from across the decades so whether you were an 70s punk, 80s new waver, 90s britpopper or early 00s poser they'll be something for everyone. We've played indie at Glasto, Isle of Wight, Latitude, Green Man, Standon, Camp Bestival and even main stage at Knebworth (but probably not the year you are thinking of), so we know our indie onions. The party will finish at 7pm so you can head to the nearest pub to continue your night out or you could just go home and watch some Saturday night TV with a take away. With a strict door policy of no under 30s (please bring ID) there is no chance of you rubbing shoulders with anyone who can't sing the entire version of Babies or Going Underground. "A feast of floppy-fringed floor-fillers" - Time Out Recommended as one of the U.K's top indie parties by BBC Radio 6 What to expect: The best in indie from: Bowie, Pulp, Clash, Jam, Cure, Joy Division, Stone Roses, Smiths, New Order, Strokes, Supergrass, Kinks, Franz Ferdinand, Nirvana, Ash, Rolling Stones, Who, Primal Scream, Killers, Sultans of Ping, Buzzcocks…

events.description: Gordon Chapman-Fox works under the name Warrington-Runcorn New Town DevelopmentPlan (WRNTDP) and produces wonderful propulsive, cinematic electronica which has amusical, conceptual and aesthetic setting in the mid 1970s to early 1980s and has made agreat impact since his debut in 2020. Gordon has released four albums to date on independent label Castles in Space. His latestrecord, The Nation’s Most Central Location has proved his most successful, charting atnumber 6 in the independent album chart and achieving much radio play and many requestsfor sync placements. Following a solid upwards trajectory, all four WRNTDP albums have had increasing levels ofcritical and commercial success, with the third record Districts, Roads, Open Space chartingat #20 in the UK vinyl album charts, and #60 in the main album chart. The album madeseveral albums of the year lists, including Bleep, Norman Records, Piccadilly Records, DriftRecords and made #5 in the Electronic Sound magazine 2022 best of list.
